top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a mature, independently replicated discovery chain: proglucagon processing and GLP-1 secretion physiology (Holst), GLP-1 biology and therapeutic rationale (Drucker), and identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) form (Mojsov). It was established as physiology before any drug existed and is now confirmed by large randomized outcome trials in diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular and renal disease. The allocation to three names and the citation scope are defensible, and no award would withhold recognition from work of clear benefit to humankind.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; co-authorship with committee colleague Sten Linnarsson and with Jonas Frisen, neither a credited name; shared KI affiliation is not a conflict
